notes:
6.9.0: declares glibc-tools, glibc-gconv and the -dev outputs of zlib, zstd, libarchive, libuuid and libblkid (ADR-0371 decision E, cix#350): a build composes a tool only at a version whose every output is installed somewhere (ADR-0372), and this image is where they are.

6.8.0: declares glibc-dev: glibc 2.44-21 moved its headers, CRT objects, linker scripts and static archives to that output (ADR-0371 decision E, cix#350), and this image carries a compiler. A composed build gets it with glibc either way (ADR-0372, cix 0.2.57-674).

6.7.0: declares curl-tools, openssl-tools, ncurses-tools and ncurses-terminfo, the outputs the curl, openssl and ncurses commands and the terminfo database moved to (ADR-0371 decision E, cix#350). A build composes a tool only at a version whose every output is installed somewhere (ADR-0372), and this image is where they are.

6.6.0: drops squashfs-tools and squashfs-tools-extra again: squashfs-tools ships libgcc_s.so.1, which gcc owns in this image (#553), so it was refused here. cix-hosttools 2.4.7 carries the output beside its main package.

6.5.0: declares squashfs-tools and dosfstools with their new outputs, squashfs-tools-extra and dosfstools-extra (ADR-0371 decision E, cix#350). cix and its probes declare both as build tools, and a build composes a tool only at a version whose main package and every output are installed somewhere (ADR-0372).

6.4.0: declares xz-tools and xz-dev, xz's new outputs (ADR-0371 decision E, cix#350): builds compose a tool at the newest version whose main package and every output are installed somewhere (ADR-0372), and this image is where they are.

6.3.0: declares openssl-dev, curl-dev and ncurses-dev, the build-time outputs those three packages gained in openssl 3.0.20-8, curl 8.21.0-8 and ncurses 6.6-12 (ADR-0372, cix#350). A build declaring tool "openssl" composes its whole build, which the composer takes from installed packages, so the outputs have to be installed somewhere, and this image is where every build tool already lives. They roll with their main packages.

6.2.2: libsodium 1.0.20-5, built with gcc. The tcc build placed its thread-local data at local-exec TLS offsets, which in a shared library alias the loading program's own TLS (cix#652); cix's install-time ELF gate refuses it (cix#653).
